description: Organize clutter and keep your homes organized with the Juggernaut Storage 56 Inch 4 Shelf Plastic Utility Shelving Storage Unit. You never have to worry about storing your items loosely in garages, basements, pantries, warehouses, or any other unorganized space. With this robust yet lightweight storage unit featuring 4 ventilated shelves, you can finally transform any cluttered home or office space into a spotless and organized one. Sturdy feet elevate the shelving system which helps to avoid water damage to items on the lowest shelf. Thanks to the well-built plastic construction, the utility storage shelving unit will never rust, dent, or peel, and is resistant to damage from chemicals. You can put together this standalone shelving unit in minutes with no tools required to allow for a quick and easy setup in any space. Supporting up to 150 pounds per shelf, this utility storage shelving unit is capable of supporting the weight of heavy tools and accessories, which makes it highly functional and extremely convenient. Do more without compromising space all year round with the Juggernaut Storage 56 Inch 4 Shelf Plastic Utility Shelving Storage Unit.
